Title: Shared DM-RS specification engine
CurrentFinding: DMRS support is present in data-channel wrappers, but the complete declared mapping-type/configuration/port/additional-position matrix is not independently release-gated.
ProductionImplementation: Implement one release-pinned PDSCH/PUSCH DM-RS resource, sequence and port engine. It must own mapping A/B, type-A position, configuration types 1/2, length 1/2, additional positions, scrambling identities, logical ports, CDM groups, OCC, hopping, exact zero-based REs and receiver estimation.
MandatoryAcceptance: Every enabled tuple must match an independent index/sequence vector and pass no-noise plus frequency-selective fading round trips.

Title: Complete selected CSI-RS profiles
CurrentFinding: CSI-RS resource types, densities, rows, periodicity, muting, zero-power resources, interference measurement, and reporting associations are only partially implemented.
ProductionImplementation: Implement immutable RRC-owned NZP-CSI-RS, ZP-CSI-RS and CSI-IM resources/resource sets with exact row, density, CDM, ports, symbols, subcarrier offsets, periodic/semi-persistent/aperiodic triggering, muting, QCL and report associations.
MandatoryAcceptance: Every declared row/type must have exact RE ownership and measured report tests. Unsupported rows fail before grid generation.

Title: Replace one-port SRS mini-profile
CurrentFinding: The strict SRS anchor is a one-port periodic full-carrier 24-RB FR1 mini profile.
ProductionImplementation: Keep the current anchor explicitly named, then implement selected one/two/four-port periodic, semi-persistent and aperiodic SRS resource sets with exact comb, cyclic shift, sequence ID, bandwidth, repetition, symbol placement and usage.
MandatoryAcceptance: All declared resources map and decode exactly; unsupported tuples return typed planning errors and generate no waveform.

Title: Multi-port and hopping SRS
CurrentFinding: Multi-port SRS, antenna switching, codebook/non-codebook sounding, resource-set triggering, hopping, and full-BWP coverage are incomplete.
ProductionImplementation: Implement SRS antenna switching, codebook and non-codebook usage, intra-resource hopping, full/partial-BWP sounding, resource-set trigger ownership, DCI/RRC activation and receiver channel/covariance estimation.
MandatoryAcceptance: Independent maps and closed-loop SRS-to-RI/SRI/TPMI decisions pass for fresh, stale, wrong-UE and wrong-resource cases.

Title: Causal SRS scheduler state
CurrentFinding: Connected scheduler use, reciprocity assumptions, timestamping, and aging of SRS estimates remain incomplete.
ProductionImplementation: Create timestamped ULChannelSoundingState with UE/cell/BWP/resource/beam identity, channel and covariance digests, calibration state, age and validity. The scheduler may consume only a valid measured state.
MandatoryAcceptance: Changing measured SRS changes the selected rank/precoder. Configured TPMI and stale/wrong-resource estimates cannot drive a strict grant.

Title: Tracking-reference-signal profiles
CurrentFinding: The strict TRS path is a one-port, two-slot mini profile rather than the broad tracking-reference-signal procedure.
ProductionImplementation: Model TRS as the selected NZP-CSI-RS tracking resource set with exact resources, periodicity, QCL association and receiver measurement state rather than as a generic one-port two-slot token.
MandatoryAcceptance: Exact TRS maps and no-oracle timing/frequency/channel estimates pass for every declared profile.

Title: Closed-loop timing and frequency tracking
CurrentFinding: TRS timing/CFO estimates are reported, but full closed-loop correction into subsequent demodulation is not proven.
ProductionImplementation: Add a stateful timing/CFO tracker with acquisition, loop update, age, confidence, correction application to later samples and residual-error lineage. No configured Doppler/CFO may substitute for an estimate.
MandatoryAcceptance: Impairment sweeps demonstrate reduced residual timing/CFO and improved downstream EVM/BLER without true-value receiver inputs.

Title: Complete PT-RS tracking evidence
CurrentFinding: PTRS before/after phase-tracking EVM and BLER evidence is partial for both DL and UL.
ProductionImplementation: Implement exact DL and UL PT-RS density, offset, port association, sequence and mapping together with joint DM-RS/PT-RS common-phase-error estimation and correction.
MandatoryAcceptance: Independent PT-RS maps pass and measured phase/EVM/BLER before/after curves demonstrate benefit and failure boundaries.

Title: Release-accurate CSI Part 1/Part 2
CurrentFinding: CSI payload construction is a custom compact container rather than release-accurate CSI Part 1/Part 2 serialization.
ProductionImplementation: Replace custom compact RI/PMI/CQI packing with typed report-configuration-dependent CSI fields, exact Part 1/Part 2 ownership, TS 38.212 UCI serialization and canonical PUCCH/PUSCH transport.
MandatoryAcceptance: Every enabled report configuration packs, transmits, decodes and reconstructs bit-exactly; the decoded report updates scheduler state.

Title: Measured-only CSI acquisition
CurrentFinding: Wideband CSI can fall back to configured SNR and rough CQI mapping when measured channel quality is unavailable.
ProductionImplementation: Strict CSI generation requires receiver-derived channel, interference/noise and reference-signal measurements with resource identity, timestamp, age and confidence. Remove configured-SNR and rough-CQI fallbacks.
MandatoryAcceptance: Deleting measured inputs or replacing them with configured SNR fails closed. All strict CSI decisions carry observed provenance.

Title: Calibrated CQI/MCS mapping
CurrentFinding: CQI-to-required-SINR tables are lab defaults because 38.214 specifies CQI/MCS tables but not universal channel-independent thresholds.
ProductionImplementation: Create versioned calibration datasets keyed by direction, waveform, MCS/CQI table, receiver, channel, rank, numerology, DM-RS/PT-RS profile and target BLER. Do not call laboratory thresholds normative.
MandatoryAcceptance: Per-MCS calibration and held-out validation reproduce the target BLER within declared confidence and error bounds.

Title: Calibrated EESM/MIESM
CurrentFinding: EESM beta can fall back to an uncalibrated 1.5-dB laboratory default.
ProductionImplementation: Implement linear-domain EESM and selected MIESM mapping with calibration parameters keyed by the complete operating profile. Missing calibration is a strict error; 1.5 dB fallback is removed.
MandatoryAcceptance: Independent formulas pass and held-out frequency-selective drops predict BLER within configured bounds.

Title: Stable per-UE OLLA
CurrentFinding: OLLA state exists, but long-run target-BLER convergence, stability, saturation, reset, and multi-UE behavior are not publication-gated.
ProductionImplementation: Implement event-sourced per-UE/per-direction/per-table OLLA with separate ACK/NACK steps, target-BLER-consistent drift, saturation, reset, ageing, DTX policy and state provenance.
MandatoryAcceptance: Multi-seed campaigns converge to target BLER, remain bounded, reset correctly and show no cross-UE/cell leakage.

Title: Bootstrap versus measured operation
CurrentFinding: Bootstrap/configured CQI or MCS paths can seed scheduling and may be confused with measured adaptation.
ProductionImplementation: Create an explicit bounded acquisition state. Bootstrap CQI/MCS may be used only before valid measurement/report acquisition and must be separately labelled and excluded from measured steady-state results.
MandatoryAcceptance: After transition, every MCS decision is caused by a decoded valid report or measured SRS state; bootstrap never reappears silently.

Title: Calibrated measurement ageing and smoothing
CurrentFinding: Doppler-adaptive smoothing and aging use simulator heuristics rather than a calibrated receiver/feedback model.
ProductionImplementation: Parameterize filtering, prediction and ageing by report periodicity, processing/feedback latency, measured mobility/coherence and calibration data. Treat this as receiver policy, not a normative constant.
MandatoryAcceptance: Held-out mobility sweeps bound stale-report error and maintain target-BLER stability without simulator-truth mobility inputs.

Title: TS 38.215 measurement registry
CurrentFinding: Physical-layer measurement coverage is partial; definitions, averaging windows, validity, antenna/beam association, and reporting breadth are not complete.
ProductionImplementation: Create a versioned registry for selected SS-RSRP, CSI-RSRP, SS-RSRQ, CSI-RSRQ, SS-SINR, CSI-SINR, RSSI and SRS-RSRP profiles, including exact reference signal, RE set, averaging, units, beam/antenna association and validity.
MandatoryAcceptance: Analytical grids produce exact expected values and wrong/empty/muted/stale resources fail with typed errors.

Title: Filtering, gaps and RRM events
CurrentFinding: L1/L3 filtering, measurement gaps, beam/cell report quantities, event triggering, and handover measurement procedures are incomplete.
ProductionImplementation: Implement selected L1/L3 filtering, measurement-gap scheduling, cell/beam report configuration, event A1/A2/A3/A4/A5/A6 entry/leave conditions, hysteresis and time-to-trigger from installed RRC state.
MandatoryAcceptance: Synthetic trajectories trigger only the expected events at exact times and never measure outside allowed gaps/resources.

Title: Waveform EVM methodology
CurrentFinding: EVM masks, measurement methodology, reference-point normalization, and standards-calibrated pass/fail thresholds are not complete.
ProductionImplementation: Implement modulation/reference-point-specific EVM over intended data/reference REs, normalization, equalization and residual-error components. Keep RF mask claims separate from receiver implementation metrics.
MandatoryAcceptance: Ideal and injected-impairment waveforms hit analytical EVM values and deterministic threshold-boundary tests.
